name.value: Executive Suites Hotel and Resort Squamish

description.value: Executive Suites Hotel & Resort is an all-suite, condo-style resort on the Sea to Sky Highway, 40 minutes from both Vancouver and Whistler, making it a natural stopover for cyclists riding the corridor. The property actively courts mountain bikers with a dedicated Stay & Bike package, front-desk trail maps, and suites large enough to bring bikes inside. With 111 studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites each featuring full kitchens and private balconies, it offers touring cyclists more living space than a typical hotel room.

address.value: 40900 Tantalus Road, Garibaldi Highlands Squamish, British Columbia, V8B 0R3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM contact details (phone 1-877-815-0048, address 40900 Tantalus Road). The /biking/ subpage explicitly states 'All suites are large enough that you can bring your bikes in for the night,' confirming bikes-in-rooms as secure storage. The same page references front-desk bike trail maps and rental referrals, indicating some staff cycling familiarity, but does not explicitly describe a formal bike intake procedure for loaded touring bikes or e-bikes, so that criterion remains null. In-suite laundry with washer/dryer is confirmed on the /extended-stays/ page; on-site dining (Free Bird Table & Bar, Norman Rudy's) is confirmed on the front page.
concerns: Website address includes 'Garibaldi Highlands' as a neighbourhood and postal code V8B 0R3, which OSM omits; top-level address updated to website's more complete version.
OSM tags internet_access=wlan with internet_access:fee=yes, but Wi-Fi is not mentioned on the website; marked null per rules.
In-suite laundry is explicitly confirmed only for extended-stay suites; availability for standard nightly suites is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational all-suite resort actively promoting cycling tourism with explicit bike-in-room policy and a Stay & Bike package; strong candidate for the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: The /biking/ page also notes front-desk bike trail maps and willingness to refer guests to local rental shops, suggesting at least baseline staff cycling awareness even if a formal bike-intake procedure is not described.
